title: Live Activities | Apple Developer Documentation - [StandBy presentation](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/live-activities\#StandBy-presentation)
claim: Consider using the default background color in StandBy.** The default background color seamlessly blends your Live Activity with the device bezel, achieves a softer look that integrates with a person’s surroundings, and allows the system to scale the Live Activity slightly larger because it doesn’t need to account for the margins around the TrueDepth camera.
